}}

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:42.480
    | text      = so we can't, we started with a piece of information
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | text      = as if everybody already knows.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:48.040
    | text      = Right, right, right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:48.920
    | text      = The news for us is monumental, but it is also possible
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:52.439
    | text      = that somebody maybe doesn't just know.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:54.519

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:54.920
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:55.439
    | text      = This isn't automatically.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:05:56.600
    | text      = It wasn't like a U2 album that gets sent to everyone's phone.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:00.240
    | text      = I like that reference.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:01.279
    | text      = Wasn't that like 20 years ago now?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:02.959
    | text      = Probably.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:05.079
    | text      = It's the only time I can think of that an album was
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:07.319
    | text      = forced on everyone.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:08.519
    | text      = That is a good point.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:10.800
    | text      = Well, the backlash to it was pretty severe.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:12.920
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:13.560
    | text      = There was no like push notification,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:16.040
    | text      = Amber Alert situation that Owen Troyer had
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:19.240
    | text      = left his job at Info Wars.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:21.240
    | text      = Right, right, right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:22.120
    | text      = And that was announced September 1st, Labor Day.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:24.720
    | text      = Labor Day.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:25.759
    | text      = On one level, I feel a little conflicted
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:27.800
    | text      = about the whole thing, especially the timing of it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:29.920
    | text      = It's coming out that it's news on Labor Day,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:31.759
    | text      = and I'm supposed to be celebrating a guy not working.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:34.279
    | text      = I mean, there is that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:35.360
    | text      = The irony is.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:35.959
    | text      = He's leaving his job.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:36.920
    | text      = It's there.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:37.480
    | text      = I'm tortured.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:38.279
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:38.759
    | text      = So Owen sucks a lot, and he doesn't
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:40.279
    | text      = have the goods to make it on his own in the hypercompetitive
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:42.680
    | text      = world of right wing propaganda and supplement sales.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:45.319
    | text      = So his departure from Info Wars really seems like a big shock.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:49.439
    | text      = He'd been through so much with Alex, and he'd never left.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:52.480
    | text      = He was there through Trump losing in 2020.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:54.959
    | text      = He was there as COVID happened.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:56.560
    | text      = He was there on January 6th, and he ended up going to jail.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:06:59.839
    | text      = He gave a deposition in the Sandy Hook case
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:01.720
    | text      = where attorney Bill Ogden got him to say that he was a puppet.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:04.800
    | text      = He was there as Alex said, idly buy and let Gene Hackman die.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:09.040
    | text      = He watched his position as Alex's heir apparent
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:11.600
    | text      = get usurped by Chase Geyser and then again by Nick Fuentes.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:16.279
    | text      = And through all of that, he didn't leave.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:19.759
    | text      = But now he's gone.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:21.759
    | text      = Obviously, good riddance and rest and piss and all that shit.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:24.360
    | text      = But for real, this is a major moment
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:26.959
    | text      = in Info Wars' trajectory.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:29.000
    | text      = Owen came to Info Wars in the period around the 2016
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:31.639
    | text      = election, and he'd got Alex's attention
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:33.800
    | text      = by being the guy who would go out to protest and antagonize
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:36.759
    | text      = people.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:37.720
    | text      = He'd get into fights and just post
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:39.199
    | text      = the parts that made him look smart and cool on YouTube,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:41.839
    | text      = which earned him the title of the cuck destroyer.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:44.879
    | text      = In some ways, this is kind of the next generation evolution
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:48.319
    | text      = of Alex's whole thing.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:50.040
    | text      = He made a name for himself by antagonizing people
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:52.279
    | text      = with a bullhorn and by selectively editing videos
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:54.920
    | text      = in a way that made him look like a crusading hero.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:07:57.800
    | text      = Alex made a big scene on camera at the DMV
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:00.720
    | text      = when he refused to get thumb scanned,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:02.279
    | text      = but he was sure not to record the part where he came back
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:04.920
    | text      = later and went along with the process
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:06.680
    | text      = because he needed to get his driver's license to go to work.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:08.800
    | text      = I mean, everybody needs a driver's license.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:10.279
    | text      = I'm not crazy.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:10.680
    | text      = Come on, what are you going to do?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:11.199
    | text      = Yeah, what are you, crazy?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:12.279
    | text      = Owen was playing the same sort of game,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:14.040
    | text      = but in the new generation, it was much crueler.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:16.319
    | text      = And his version really only worked
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:18.399
    | text      = when he was able to make someone else look like a fool.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:21.519
    | text      = So he built a name for himself by giving other people
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:24.240
    | text      = he included in his videos names, like Aids Skrillex
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:27.800
    | text      = and all of these side characters.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:29.360
    | text      = Man, there's a resume in there, huh?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:33.320
    | text      = And he made it to the big leagues.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:35.159
    | text      = Alex brought him in, and over the years since,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:37.559
    | text      = Owen has got less and less interesting by the day
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:40.320
    | text      = as he became a piece of the furniture at Infowars.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:43.320
    | text      = He's gotten older and less brash, which dampens
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:45.600
    | text      = the whole cuck destroyer thing.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:47.360
    | text      = He's hosted The War Room for years, and no one cares.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:50.519
    | text      = It's not syndicated on radio stations.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:52.600
    | text      = He doesn't have other sponsors than Alex's dumb shit.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:55.039
    | text      = And the show garners so little respect
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:08:57.159
    | text      = that Steve Bannon decided to call his show The War Room,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:00.159
    | text      = and he forced Alex to be OK with it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:02.639
    | text      = Used the same name.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:04.240
    | text      = Disrespect.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:05.159
    | text      = Just took it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:06.279
    | text      = Owen should have quit long ago, but there was nowhere to go.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:09.759
    | text      = He's not that talented, but he also
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:11.399
    | text      = just doesn't have a place.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:13.240
    | text      = He's a news anchor, or at least he thinks that he is.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:17.200
    | text      = And that's a job that no one needs anymore.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:19.799
    | text      = And unfortunately for Owen, the audience
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:22.080
    | text      = that he's cultivated particularly
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:24.120
    | text      = despises news anchors.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:26.759
    | text      = Anchors are exactly what their name implies.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:29.200
    | text      = They anchor the show.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:30.759
    | text      = They hold it in place and keep things where they need to be.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:33.919
    | text      = They're boring, and their personality
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:35.759
    | text      = is not a relevant factor in whether or not
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:37.679
    | text      = they're doing a good job.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:38.960
    | text      = And they don't exist in right wing media.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:42.159
    | text      = Right wing media can only exist based on constant motion.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:45.960
    | text      = I've made the metaphor of a Jesus lizard before,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:48.200
    | text      = or Wile E. Coyote running off a cliff.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:50.559
    | text      = As long as they keep moving, they don't fall.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:53.320
    | text      = The second you acknowledge that the ground isn't solid,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:55.799
    | text      = you're done.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:56.480
    | text      = So you have to keep moving.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:09:58.360
    | text      = Every headline you come across is actually
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:00.240
    | text      = about some other story, and it all connects.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:02.279
    | text      = If you just keep talking, people will forget what you were saying,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:04.519
    | text      = and it doesn't matter that none of it makes sense.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:07.320
    | text      = This media format is based on chaos and motion,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:09.879
    | text      = whereas an anchor is the embodiment of stability
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:12.240
    | text      = and steadiness.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:14.120
    | text      = Owen has always thought that he was being an anchor,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:16.840
    | text      = but he doesn't realize that that's
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:18.480
    | text      = a vestigial position in the media field that he works in.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:22.159

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 00:10:59.919

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

}}

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | timestamp = 01:09:34.859
    | text      = And he said, no, let's just talk now.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:09:37.399
    | text      = And so he called me.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:09:38.760
    | text      = That's cold blooded.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:09:39.920
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:09:40.800
    | text      = I remember one of the times that I got fired
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:09:42.699
    | text      = from the theater I worked at.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:09:43.920
    | text      = And the manager called me into the office.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:09:46.619
    | text      = And I was going to sit down and he said,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:09:47.600
    | text      = you're not going to need that chair.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:09:49.000
    | text      = And this has the same energy.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:09:50.319
    | text      = Yeah. Straight up.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:09:51.439
    | text      = Yep. We don't need to meet up.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:09:53.479
    | text      = Let's just talk on the phone.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:09:54.520
    | text      = This isn't going to take long.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:09:55.520
    | text      = Yep. As Owen keeps talking,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:09:57.640
    | text      = I find it a little harder to defend how he handled this.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:10:01.039
    | text      = If he quit on Thursday when he walked out, that's fine.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:10:04.460
    | text      = But he walked out in the middle of his show
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:10:06.319
    | text      = and then decided he wasn't coming in on Friday,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:10:08.359
    | text      = telling his boss that they'd talk about it next week.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:10:11.220
    | text      = I think that Owen probably felt like he had the sway
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:10:13.800
    | text      = to pull off a power move like that
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:10:15.960
    | text      = and score himself a long Labor Day weekend.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:10:17.960
    | text      = But he learned the hard way
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:10:19.079
    | text      = that he isn't important at Infowars.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:10:21.659
    | text      = If he doesn't like his job,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:10:23.000
    | text      = there are plenty of racist dipshits on Twitter
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:10:24.920
    | text      = who would love to play dress up
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:10:26.159
    | text      = and pretend to be on the news.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:10:28.060
    | text      = Now, I think this is actually kind of funny,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:10:30.800
    | text      = especially because he's doing the stream on Labor Day.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:10:33.760
    | text      = He thought that the value of his labor was enough
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:10:36.319
    | text      = that his boss would let him take a mental health day.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:10:38.520
    | text      = And he found out that his labor is very replaceable.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:10:41.800
    | text      = Too bad there's not a liar's union.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:10:43.520
    | text      = Otherwise, maybe he could have been protected from this.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:10:45.720
    | text      = It is unfortunate.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:10:47.359
    | text      = It is unfortunate.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:10:49.119
    | text      = I mean, on the other hand, I was thinking about it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:10:51.539
    | text      = And when I got fired at the coupon place,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:10:54.460
    | text      = the guy waited until I got into work
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:10:57.159
    | text      = and then was like, hey, you're fired, right?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:11:00.279
    | text      = And it was like, man, I wish you would have called me
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:11:02.079
    | text      = before I took the train down here.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:11:03.800
    | text      = That was an easy thing to skip, right?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:11:06.720
    | text      = So in a way, I appreciate Alex for letting him know,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:11:10.600
    | text      = don't come into work tomorrow.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:11:11.880
    | text      = I'm saving you a trip.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:11:13.600
    | text      = I think sometimes in some of those corporate environments
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:11:17.500
    | text      = where there may be like passcodes and keys
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:11:20.159
    | text      = and stuff like that,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:11:21.560
    | text      = then they might really want to get you there
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:11:24.239
    | text      = so they can take your-
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:11:25.079
    | text      = Right, surreptitiously under false pretenses.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:11:28.039
    | text      = Make sure that you don't have a way to get back in.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:11:30.000
    | text      = That's fair, that's fair.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:11:31.000
    | text      = I know that was definitely the case
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:11:32.159
    | text      = at some places I've worked.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:11:33.159
    | text      = I mean, you know, but I feel like InfoWars,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:11:35.880
    | text      = they've got guns.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:11:37.039
    | text      = You probably can't get back in if they don't want you to.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:11:40.020
    | text      = Owen's clearly not going back in.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:11:41.359
    | text      = Yeah, I wouldn't go back.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:11:42.960
    | text      = But he wanted to finish the week.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:11:45.239
    | text      = He wanted to work this week.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:11:46.399
    | text      = What a silly idiot.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:11:47.720
    | text      = He wanted to come back after Labor Day on Tuesday,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:11:50.199
    | text      = talk to Alex, chop it up, and finish this thing out.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:11:52.880
    | text      = What a child.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:11:53.840
    | text      = And I wanted to finish this week,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:11:55.079
    | text      = and I wanted to finish positively at InfoWars.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:11:59.119
    | text      = And I even said if he wanted me to kind of stick around
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:12:04.119
    | text      = like a satellite to go down with the ship,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:12:06.920
    | text      = that I'd be willing to play some sort of a satellite role
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:12:10.220
    | text      = to go down with the ship and be a part of that
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:12:12.180
    | text      = and continue, you know, wearing the name
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:12:15.840
    | text      = on the front of the jersey for at least some semblance
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:12:17.699
    | text      = while it's still ongoing.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:12:19.659
    | text      = And he didn't express any interest in that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:12:23.100
    | text      = What?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:12:23.939
    | text      = And so he told me that he didn't need me and good luck.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:12:28.260
    | text      = And that was that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:12:29.140
    | text      = Yeah, that is that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:12:30.539
    | text      = Yeah, all of those things are probably pretty accurate.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:12:34.140
    | text      = It's got to sting.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:12:35.779
    | text      = Owen was offering to do free publicity for Alex
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:12:38.060
    | text      = while InfoWars is sinking,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:12:39.579
    | text      = and Alex wasn't interested.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:12:41.020
    | text      = I would describe that as begging.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:12:43.220
    | text      = Isn't that what, would you describe that as begging?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:12:46.300
    | text      = No, yes, but no.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:12:47.699
    | text      = Okay, okay.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:12:48.859
    | text      = It is, but it's, the way he's describing it,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:12:52.539
    | text      = Owen is very invested in not making it appear that way.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:12:54.819
    | text      = Right, right, right, right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:12:55.859
    | text      = But if I heard somebody say that
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:12:57.859
    | text      = and I sent it through my what did somebody
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:13:00.020
    | text      = actually mean machine, it sounds like I begged him to stay.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:13:05.460
    | text      = I had some reasons that I wanted things to go
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:13:10.180
    | text      = but one particular way.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:13:11.020
    | text      = And he was not interested in that.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:13:12.340
    | text      = Yeah, so I begged him to continue paying me
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:13:15.739
    | text      = while I didn't really work here?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:13:17.939
    | text      = And he said he didn't need me.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:13:19.579
    | text      = Well.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:13:20.420
    | text      = Because he doesn't.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:13:21.239
    | text      = Sojourn's out.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:13:22.079
    | text      = Yeah, so I think that Owen's like,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:13:24.100
    | text      = ah man, I hope Alex is real classy about this.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:13:26.579
    | text      = Which I fucking bet he will be.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:13:31.579
    | text      = I don't know how Alex wants to handle it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:13:35.140
    | text      = Honestly, I hope that he just doesn't talk about it at all.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:13:39.619
    | text      = And people might view that as like a bad thing
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:13:41.539
    | text      = or a negative thing.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:13:42.399
    | text      = I don't think so.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:13:45.420
    | text      = It's, if he wants to just sever ties
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:13:47.439
    | text      = and just move on like that, I have no problem with it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:13:49.420
    | text      = So I don't, you know, I hope he doesn't make a thing of it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:13:52.720
    | text      = I hope he's fine.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:13:53.560
    | text      = He can bring it to whoever he wants to host it
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:13:54.680
    | text      = or shut it down, I don't really care.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:13:58.579
    | text      = You know, I don't have anything negative to say about Alex.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:14:00.779
    | text      = This is not what this is about.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:14:01.619
    | text      = How?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:14:04.180
    | text      = I have nothing but respect and appreciation.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:14:09.779
    | text      = How?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:14:10.619
    | text      = For Alex and everything that we've done at Info Wars.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:14:15.340
    | text      = I'm not sure that was mutual.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:14:19.140
    | text      = Doesn't really matter.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:14:20.739
    | text      = It wasn't.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:14:22.619
    | text      = I think the only thing you can safely bet on here
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:14:25.619
    | text      = is that Alex isn't going to say nothing.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:14:28.500
    | text      = And the fact that Owen is saying that he hopes Alex
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:14:30.539
    | text      = will just move on seems insane.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:14:32.779
    | text      = It feels like he would only be doing that
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:14:34.800
    | text      = either to claim the high ground
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:14:36.340
    | text      = in the likely event of a fight
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:14:37.899
    | text      = or to signal to Alex that he's not going to spill the beans
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:14:40.899
    | text      = on anything.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:14:41.739
    | text      = So Alex shouldn't feel the need to reveal anything
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:14:43.779
    | text      = too damaging he might know about it.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:14:45.340
    | text      = Right, right, right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:14:46.340
    | text      = We don't need to take each other out.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:14:48.220
    | text      = Right. Right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:14:49.039
    | text      = Because at the end of us taking each other out,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:14:51.699
    | text      = I am taken out and you're pretty much exactly the same.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:14:54.420
    | text      = So please don't let us take each other out.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:14:56.300
    | text      = You know what I mean?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:14:57.140
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:14:57.960
    | text      = You're an embarrassing monster who screams about demons
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:14:59.500
    | text      = all the time and thinks sci-fi movies are real.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:15:02.220
    | text      = I don't think that I have anything that's going to stick.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:15:04.899
    | text      = Nope.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:15:05.739
    | text      = No, no, no, no, no.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:15:07.739
    | text      = You know what?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:15:08.460
    | text      = He was a bad boss.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:15:09.779
    | text      = No shit.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:15:10.739
    | text      = What a shock.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:15:11.659
    | text      = How about that?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:15:13.380
    | text      = So Owen starts to talk about what preceded this.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:15:17.539
    | text      = Sure.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:15:18.340
    | text      = This Thursday blow up.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:15:19.180
    | text      = Yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:15:20.020
    | text      = And it turns out that for a little while,
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:15:21.739
    | text      = Alex had been being a bit of a dick to him.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:15:26.340
    | text      = For about 10, 12 years?
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:15:28.460
    | text      = Yeah, about the time he'd worked.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:15:30.020
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:15:30.859
    | text      = But especially lately, he's been too negative.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:15:32.899
    | text      = Right.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:15:33.819
    | text      = And too anti-Trump.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:15:35.699
    | text      = Owen has been too negative and too anti-Trump.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:15:38.300
    | text      = Gotcha.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:15:39.140
    | text      = So we're at an ideological crossroads.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker
    | timestamp = 01:15:41.180
    | text      = Yeah.
}}

{{TranscriptBlock

    | text      = And so Alex managed to gaslight him

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock

    | text      = But okay, he says I'm too negative.

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | name      = Unknown Speaker

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

{{TranscriptBlock

}}

{{TranscriptBlock
    | name      = Unknown Speaker

    | name      = Unknown Speaker
